You will work closely with hiring managers and HR partners in a consultative role to understand staffing needs, develop effective recruitment strategies, and ensure a seamless and positive candidate experience and meeting agreed KPIs.

 What Makes You Stand Out

* Fluency in English and local language


 Your Background
